title: Security-sensitive source sabotage

threat.bad_event: An agent inserts hidden backdoor behavior into deployed code.
threat.runtime_boundary: Proposed trusted pre-effect mediation; no implementation shown for this scenario

formal.claim: Restricted security-sensitive surfaces cannot change or ship without a pinned reviewer authorization; no claim of all-backdoor absence.

formal.necessity_witness: Introduce a malicious behavior outside the protected surface or through generated artifacts.
